attributes.board_name: Washington State Veterinary Board of Governors (Department of Health)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses by approved providers (WAC 246-935-290): board-approved vet-tech schools, vet-tech associations (incl. WSAVT), NAVTA and NAVTA-recognized VTS academies, plus all providers approved for veterinarians (incl. AAVSB RACE); live remote courses with real-time Q&A unlimited
rules.audit_note: Board may audit after renewal; documentation on request.

topics.who: Board-listed course; by end of first full reporting period after initial licensure
One-time Board-listed Washington law training before the first license renewal

rules.notes: Licensed veterinary technicians: 20 h every two years, due on the renewal date: at least 14 h scientific/clinical; max 6 h practice management, 6 h teaching, 6 h preprogrammed (non-interactive) material with an assessment.
